english.note: This is the all-purpose noun for general improvement or betterment.
Use this for a general improvement in a situation, condition, or result rather than for an upgraded product.

examples.english: There has been improvement in this arrangement.
examples.jyutping: ni1 go3 on1 paai4 jau5 goi2 sin6

examples.english: After changing the approach, the results showed a noticeable upgrade.
examples.traditional: 改咗個做法之後，成績有明顯改善。
examples.jyutping: goi2 zo2 go3 zou6 faat3 zi1 hau6 sing4 zik1 jau5 ming4 hin2 goi2 sin6
